command:
set -u
ROOT=/workspace/omega_runtime
REL=/workspace/omega_runtime/releases/a676258885b964efc2a80599957dc1c09dc3d43b-full-777-v1
printf '%s\n' '---RUNTIME TREE---'
find "$ROOT" -maxdepth 2 -type f -o -type l | sort | head -200
printf '%s\n' '---CURRENT LINK---'
ls -ld "$ROOT/current" 2>&1 || true
readlink -f "$ROOT/current" 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '---RELEASE TOP---'
find "$REL" -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | head -200
printf '%s\n' '---SUPERVISOR OUTER---'
sed -n '1,280p' "$REL/omega/supervisor_outer.py" 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '---SERVICE/LAUNCH REFERENCES---'
grep -Rsn --exclude='*.pyc' -E 'omega_runtime/current|supervisor_outer|full-777-v1|releases/' "$ROOT" /etc/systemd/system /root/.config/systemd 2>/dev/null | head -240 || true
